page.layout: One page: a book cover of green and grey marbled paper with a white label in the centre bearing handwritten lines. A paper spine label at the left edge is also handwritten.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The central label carries manuscript handwriting, not print, and is therefore not transcribed. It names a Latin panegyric (Panegyricus) on Ludwig Heinrich, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, dated 1659, with a further date of 1660 and a handwritten owner's name at the top. The spine label is also handwritten and partly illegible. Green marbled paper and the cover edges are not text.
